title: Packaged Drinking Water (Other than Packaged Natural Mineral Water) - Specification
scheme: ISI Mark (Scheme I)
description: Prescribes requirements and methods of sampling and testing for packaged drinking water. Mandatory certification under FSSAI and BIS regulations.
key_clauses: Clause 4.1: Quality of raw water source must be free from chemical and microbiological contamination.
Clause 5.2: Maximum permissible limit for Total Dissolved Solids (TDS) is 500 mg/l.
Clause 7.1: Mandatory ISI Mark embossing/printing along with CM/L license number and manufacturing date.
Clause 8.3: Microbiological parameters: E. coli, Coliform bacteria, Faecal Streptococci must be absent in 250 ml.

title: Welded Low Carbon Steel Cylinders for Low Pressure Liquefied Gases - LPG Cylinders
scheme: ISI Mark (Scheme I)
description: Specifies design, manufacturing, inspection, and testing of welded low carbon steel cylinders intended for storage and transportation of Liquefied Petroleum Gas (LPG).
key_clauses: Clause 3.2: Material must be micro-alloyed or low carbon steel with minimum yield strength 240 MPa.
Clause 6.1: Hydrostatic test pressure must withstand 2.5 MPa without leakage or distortion.
Clause 9.4: Permanent marking of tare weight, test date, and ISI certification mark on the stay plate.
Clause 11.2: Volumetric expansion ratio test limit max 1/5000.

title: Gold and Gold Alloys, Jewellery/Artefacts - Fineness and Marking - Specification
scheme: Hallmarking Scheme
description: Covers purity grades, fineness limits, and hallmarking requirements for gold jewellery and artefacts sold in India.
key_clauses: Clause 4.1: Recognized standard gold fineness grades: 24K (999/995), 23K (958), 22K (916), 20K (833), 18K (750), 14K (585), 9K (375).
Clause 5.1: Hallmarking comprises three mandatory marks: (1) BIS Logo, (2) Purity in Karat and Fineness (e.g. 22K916), (3) 6-digit alphanumeric HUID (Hallmark Unique Identification).
Clause 6.3: Fire assay method (IS 1418) or XRF for preliminary non-destructive screening at Assaying & Hallmarking Centres (AHC).

title: Information Technology Equipment - Safety - General Requirements
scheme: Compulsory Registration Scheme (CRS)
description: Applies to mains-powered or battery-powered information technology equipment, including electrical business equipment, laptops, mobile phones, servers, adapters.
key_clauses: Clause 1.2: Prevention of electrical shock, energy hazards, fire, mechanical and heat hazards.
Clause 2.1: Protection against electric shock and accessible parts insulation test.
Clause 4.5: Thermal resistance and flammability testing of enclosure materials (UL94 V-0 or equivalent).
Clause 5.3: Mandatory R-number (Registration Number) display along with the Standard Mark on packaging.

title: Secondary Cells and Batteries Containing Alkaline or Other Non-Acid Electrolytes - Lithium Cells & Batteries
scheme: Compulsory Registration Scheme (CRS)
description: Safety requirements for portable sealed secondary lithium cells and for batteries made from them, for use in portable electronic applications.
key_clauses: Clause 7.2: Continuous charging at constant voltage test.
Clause 7.3.2: External short circuit test (cell and battery at 55 deg C).
Clause 7.3.6: Overcharge and forced discharge tests.
Clause 8.1: Mandatory CRS Standard Mark with 'IS 16046 (Part 2)' and Unique Registration Number R-XXXXXXXX.

title: Safety of Toys - Safety Aspects Related to Mechanical and Physical Properties
scheme: ISI Mark (Scheme I) - Toys Quality Control Order
description: Specifies safety requirements and testing methods for toys intended for use by children under 14 years. Quality Control Order (QCO) makes ISI mark mandatory.
key_clauses: Clause 4.1: Small parts test to avoid choking hazards for children under 36 months.
Clause 4.7: Sharp edges and points inspection before and after drop/impact tests.
Clause 5.1: Maximum heavy metals migration limit (Lead, Cadmium, Mercury, Arsenic under IS 9873 Part 3).
Clause 7: Mandatory domestic factory audit and foreign factory audit (FMCS) prior to license grant.

title: Protective Helmets for Two Wheeler Riders - Specification
scheme: ISI Mark (Scheme I)
description: Prescribes requirements for protective helmets for everyday motorcycle and scooter riders. Non-ISI helmets are legally banned for sale under Central Motor Vehicle Rules.
key_clauses: Clause 5.1: Maximum weight of two-wheeler helmet capped at 1.2 kg to avoid cervical strain.
Clause 6.1: Impact absorption test using drop rig at -10°C, ambient, and +50°C temperatures.
Clause 7.2: Retention system dynamic test and chin strap slippage limits (max 30 mm elongation).
Clause 9.1: Permanent ISI certification mark along with helmet size (540 mm to 600 mm) embossed.

title: Ordinary Portland Cement - Specification (33, 43 and 53 Grade)
scheme: ISI Mark (Scheme I)
description: Covers manufacture and chemical/physical requirements of ordinary Portland cement. Quality Control Order mandates BIS certification for all cement plants.
key_clauses: Clause 5.1: Chemical requirements: Total loss on ignition shall not exceed 5.0%.
Clause 6.2: Minimum compressive strength for 53 Grade: 3 days (27 MPa), 7 days (37 MPa), 28 days (53 MPa).
Clause 6.4: Initial setting time not less than 30 minutes, final setting time not more than 600 minutes.
Clause 10.2: Plain packaging with ISI Mark, Grade, Month/Year of packing, and Net Quantity 50 kg.

title: High Strength Deformed Steel Bars and Wires for Concrete Reinforcement (TMT Rebars)
scheme: ISI Mark (Scheme I)
description: Specifies requirements for thermo-mechanically treated (TMT) steel bars, Fe 415, Fe 500, Fe 550, and Fe 600 grades for concrete structural reinforcement.
key_clauses: Clause 4.1: Chemical limits: Max Carbon 0.30%, Max Sulphur and Phosphorus 0.055% for Fe 500D.
Clause 7.1: Minimum proof stress/yield strength: 500 MPa for Fe 500, with minimum 16% elongation.
Clause 8.2: Bend and rebend test without signs of fracture or visible cracking.
Clause 11.1: Every metre length of bar should roll with manufacturer identification and ISI Standard Mark.

title: Polyvinyl Chloride (PVC) Insulated Unsheathed and Sheathed Cables/Cords with Rigid and Flexible Conductor
scheme: ISI Mark (Scheme I)
description: Specifies single core and multi core PVC insulated cables for working voltages up to and including 1100 V used for domestic and industrial wiring.
key_clauses: Clause 5.1: Conductor material must be high conductivity annealed electrolytic copper or aluminium.
Clause 6.1: Insulation resistance constant test at 70°C.
Clause 9.3: Spark test at 6000 V to ensure pinhole-free extrusion.
Clause 15.2: Sequential metre marking along with manufacturer name and ISI mark every metre.

title: Safety of Household and Similar Electrical Appliances - Particular Requirements for Electric Irons
scheme: ISI Mark (Scheme I)
description: Deals with the safety of electric dry irons and steam irons for household and similar purposes, rated voltage not more than 250 V.
key_clauses: Clause 8: Protection against access to live parts.
Clause 11: Heating test during normal continuous operation.
Clause 13: Electric strength and leakage current at operating temperature (max 0.75 mA).
Clause 19: Abnormal operation test including thermostat failure test.

title: Audio, Video and Similar Electronic Apparatus - Safety Requirements
scheme: Compulsory Registration Scheme (CRS)
description: Safety requirements for electronic apparatus designed to be fed from mains, supplying apparatus, batteries for home entertainment like LED TVs, amplifiers, set-top boxes.
key_clauses: Clause 4.3: Radiation safety limits for display panels and optical lasers.
Clause 9: Electric shock hazard and insulation resistance.
Clause 14: Components flammability testing.
Clause 20: Marking with BIS Standard Mark and Portal Registration Number.

title: Self-Ballasted LED Lamps for General Lighting Services - Part 1: Safety Requirements
scheme: Compulsory Registration Scheme (CRS)
description: Safety and interchangeability requirements for self-ballasted LED lamps with a supply voltage up to 250 V 50 Hz.
key_clauses: Clause 6: Cap interchangeability (B22d, E27) dimensions.
Clause 8: Insulation resistance and dielectric strength after humidity treatment.
Clause 13: Resistance to heat and fire.
Clause 14: Fault condition test.

title: Precast Concrete Blocks for Paving - Specification
scheme: ISI Mark (Scheme I - Voluntary)
description: Specifies requirements for solid, unreinforced precast cement concrete paver blocks for residential, commercial and heavy duty industrial pavements.
key_clauses: Clause 5.1: Water absorption not to exceed 6% by mass.
Clause 6.1: Compressive strength grades: M30, M35, M40, M50.
Clause 6.2: Abrasion resistance test using Bohme disc / Capon disc method.

title: Crystalline Silicon Terrestrial Photovoltaic (PV) Modules - Design Qualification and Type Approval
scheme: Compulsory Registration Scheme (CRS) - Solar QCO
description: Lay down requirements for design qualification and type approval of terrestrial crystalline silicon photovoltaic modules for long-term outdoor operation.
key_clauses: Clause 10.11: Damp heat test (85°C and 85% RH for 1000 hours).
Clause 10.12: Thermal cycling test (200 cycles from -40°C to +85°C).
Clause 10.17: Hail impact test and mechanical load test (2400 Pa).
Clause 10.18: Bypass diode thermal test.

title: Lamp Controlgear - Part 2: Particular Requirements - Section 13: d.c. or a.c. Supplied Electronic Controlgear for LED Modules
scheme: Compulsory Registration Scheme (CRS)
description: Particular safety requirements for electronic controlgear (LED drivers) for use on d.c. supplies up to 250 V and a.c. supplies up to 1000 V at 50 Hz.
key_clauses: Clause 8: Protection against electric shock.
Clause 14: Fault condition testing on driver circuit components.
Clause 16: Resistance to heat, fire and tracking.
Clause 19: Output voltage and current regulation under load variance.

title: Personal Protective Equipment - Part 2: Safety Footwear
scheme: ISI Mark (Scheme I) - Footwear QCO
description: Specifies basic and additional requirements for safety footwear equipped with toecaps designed to provide protection against impact at an energy level of at least 200 Joules.
key_clauses: Clause 5.3: Impact resistance of toecap (minimum clearance after 200 J impact).
Clause 5.4: Upper tear strength and water vapour permeability.
Clause 5.8: Outsole abrasion resistance and flex resistance test.
Clause 7: Clear embossing of ISI Mark with Category code (e.g. S1, S2, S3).

title: Electric Vehicle Conductive AC Charging System - Specification
scheme: ISI Mark / Automotive Scheme
description: Prescribes general requirements and safety provisions for AC charging stations and EVSE (Electric Vehicle Supply Equipment).
key_clauses: Clause 6.2: Insulation coordination and dielectric withstand voltage.
Clause 8.1: Grounding conductor continuity monitoring and automatic disconnect within 40 ms.
Clause 11.4: IP54 minimum ingress protection rating for outdoor charging units.
Clause 14: Interoperability testing with Indian vehicle inlets.
